line=""

  prev="$a"

printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$d/gh.log"
if [ -f "$d/gh.fail" ]; then echo "fake gh: boom" >&2; exit 1; fi
if [ -f "$d/gh.out" ]; then cat "$d/gh.out"; else echo "https://github.com/acme-fork/app/pull/7"; fi
